content: 6. Conclusion

We introduced a novel attack vector against invisible wa-termarks by framing removal as view synthesis. Our zero-shot diffusion-based framework applies controlled view-point shifts in latent space combined with view-guided cor-respondence attention to remove watermarks while preserv-ing semantic content.Without requiring detector accessor watermark knowledge, RAVEN achieves state-of-the-artsuppression across 14 watermarking schemes and 15 at-tack baselines. This work exposes a critical vulnerability tosemantic-preserving geometric transformations, motivatingthe design of more resilient watermarking mechanisms.
